E1.evidence: Reproduction ("Launch moveit_servo as a ComposableNode.") and the resulting error: "Component constructor threw an exception: intraprocess communication is not allowed with a zero qos history depth value" -- https://github.com/moveit/moveit2/issues/2632 . Maintainer confirmation: "I recall seeing that warning when testing, and am OK with the fix in #722 to not enable it." -- https://github.com/moveit/moveit2/issues/2632#issuecomment-1877117619 ; the same error was reported earlier by a maintainer in https://github.com/moveit/moveit2/pull/722 ("[ERROR] [test_servo_integration_container]: Component constructor threw an exception: intraprocess communication is not allowed with a zero qos history depth value").

E2.evidence:
moveit_servo's ServoNode creates its publishers and subscriptions through rclcpp with rclcpp::SystemDefaultsQoS() (e.g. "node_->create_publisher<moveit_msgs::msg::ServoStatus>(servo_params_.status_topic, rclcpp::SystemDefaultsQoS());" -- https://github.com/moveit/moveit2/blob/2.8.0/moveit_ros/moveit_servo/src/servo_node.cpp), which rclcpp turns into keep-last with depth 0 ("case RMW_QOS_POLICY_HISTORY_SYSTEM_DEFAULT:
      return KeepLast(rmw_qos.depth, false);" -- https://github.com/ros2/rclcpp/blob/24.0.0/rclcpp/src/rclcpp/qos.cpp). When the node is constructed with intra-process enabled, rclcpp rejects that QoS value at entity creation ("if (qos.depth() == 0) {
        throw std::invalid_argument(
                "intraprocess communication is not allowed with a zero qos history depth value");" -- https://github.com/ros2/rclcpp/blob/24.0.0/rclcpp/include/rclcpp/publisher.hpp). The failure is a QoS value crossing the moveit_servo -> rclcpp API boundary that the provider refuses; it is not a crash in either unit's own logic, not a name binding, not a build change.

E3.evidence: PAIR: moveit_servo passes QoS profiles and NodeOptions (use_intra_process_comms) into rclcpp's create_publisher/create_subscription when the Servo composable node is loaded with extra_arguments=[{'use_intra_process_comms' : True}], as the warning advises: "Intra-process communication is disabled, consider enabling it by adding:  extra_arguments=[{'use_intra_process_comms' : True}] to the Servo composable node in the launch file" -- https://github.com/moveit/moveit2/issues/2632

E4.evidence: Observed refusal: "However, this will lead to the following error:\r\n`Component constructor threw an exception: intraprocess communication is not allowed with a zero qos history depth value`" and "Following advice of the warning leads to an error." -- https://github.com/moveit/moveit2/issues/2632

failed_conditions.quote: Component constructor threw an exception: intraprocess communication is not allowed with a zero qos history depth value

loudness_evidence: Runtime-enforced refusal when the component is constructed: "Component constructor threw an exception: intraprocess communication is not allowed with a zero qos history depth value" -- https://github.com/moveit/moveit2/issues/2632 (the component container reports it as "[ERROR] [test_servo_integration_container]: Component constructor threw an exception: ..." in https://github.com/moveit/moveit2/pull/722).

resolution.summary: PR #2752 deletes the ServoNode warning that tells users to enable use_intra_process_comms. It does not change the QoS that ServoNode passes to rclcpp, so the refused composition (Servo component with intra-process enabled) still fails; the practical remedy is to leave intra-process disabled. Re-enabling intra-process was deferred to moveit2#2753, pending rclcpp support.
resolution.evidence: Diff of PR #2752 only removes the `if (!options.use_intra_process_comms())` warning block from moveit_ros/moveit_servo/src/servo_node.cpp -- https://github.com/moveit/moveit2/pull/2752/files ; at the merge commit 0f24369749e908040bdb05708993a1250edbdea9 servo_node.cpp still uses rclcpp::SystemDefaultsQoS() for its publishers and subscriptions. Reporter afterwards: "You don't need to avoid the composable node. The only thing you need to avoid is following the warnings advice, since this will lead to an error." -- https://github.com/moveit/moveit2/issues/2632#issuecomment-2362965448

notes: Class `other` is used because the refused attribute is the history kind/depth of the QoS profile on the intra-process path; the listed QoS classes cover only reliability, durability and deadline. The source does not name the specific entity that triggered the exception (reporter: "I did not find anything in the moveit code"); the implicated create_publisher/SystemDefaultsQoS elements are inferred from the code: the message text is thrown by rclcpp's Publisher::post_init_setup (the subscription path throws a differently worded message), and ServoNode's publishers at 2.8.0 use rclcpp::SystemDefaultsQoS(), which rclcpp 24.0.0 maps to KeepLast with depth 0. PR #2752's description attributes the problem to missing KEEP_ALL support (ros2/rclcpp#752); per the primary code the rejected value is keep-last with depth 0, not KEEP_ALL. History: the same refusal was hit in 2021 and handled by disabling use_intra_process_comms in the servo launch files (moveit2 PR #722); the warning was left in place and is what this issue addresses. Other composition not specified: none. A Humble user reports the warning still appears there (https://github.com/moveit/moveit2/issues/2632#issuecomment-2361907290); no backport of #2752 was traced.
